svg.title: git: start a project history.
svg.desc: A repository is a project directory with Git's local version history. Requires Git; missing tools refer to the Package Management chapter. Inside an existing project directory, git init creates the hidden .git directory storing history and settings. Two aligned blocks show initialization and repository-only identity settings. Names and emails are stored in commits and travel with shared commits; they are not login credentials.
svg.text: Git records versions of your project files locally.
A repository is a project directory with Git's history and settings.
